sourceItems.title: 国家发展改革委发布生猪价格过度下跌三级预警
normalizedClaims: Hog prices had fallen enough for the hog-to-grain ratio to enter the level-3 excessive-decline warning zone; NDRC cited concentrated heavy-hog selling, frozen-pork imports and weak seasonal demand.

sourceItems.title: 猪粮比价进入过度下跌一级预警区间
normalizedClaims: June 21-25 average hog-to-grain ratio fell to 4.90:1, triggering the highest excessive-decline warning and planned central/local pork reserve purchases.
observedChanges: hog cycle reaches severe loss zone

sourceItems.title: China to buy pork for state reserves to support prices
normalizedClaims: Live hog prices had plunged about 65% from the start of 2021 to early June; the reserve-purchase plan followed a severe profitability collapse, while spot prices had begun rebounding from a June 21 low.

sourceItems.title: Copper hits record high on demand hope, tight supply
normalizedClaims: Copper hit record highs in London and Shanghai after more than 30% YTD gains, supported by recovery/green-demand expectations and tight concentrate supply.

sourceItems.title: China's industrial commodities slide after Beijing warns of market crackdown
normalizedClaims: Iron ore, coking coal and steel fell more than 5% after China announced measures to curb soaring raw-material prices and speculation.

sourceItems.title: 2021年5月份工业生产者出厂价格同比上涨9.0%
normalizedClaims: May PPI +9.0% YoY/+1.6% MoM; mining producer prices +36.4%, non-ferrous input prices +28.0% YoY and ferrous inputs +26.8%, confirming a broad upstream profit/input-cost shock.

sourceItems.title: China confirms metal stocks release from state reserves
normalizedClaims: China confirmed releases of copper, aluminum and zinc from state reserves to downstream processors to stabilize supply and prices; futures had already begun trending lower.

sourceItems.title: Sales of New Energy Vehicles in April 2021
normalizedClaims: April NEV sales reached 206k, +180.3% YoY; Jan-Apr NEV sales 732k, +249.2% YoY.

sourceItems.title: Production of New Energy Vehicles in May 2021
normalizedClaims: May NEV production reached 217k, +151.7% YoY; Jan-May production 967k, +224% YoY.

sourceItems.title: Nissan, Suzuki Motor to curtail production in June due to chip shortage
normalizedClaims: Nissan and Suzuki planned June production curtailments because semiconductor shortages were still constraining vehicle output; Mitsubishi also planned production reductions.

sourceItems.title: 12-inch Fab Capacities for Automotive Semiconductor Undergo Most Severe Shortage
normalizedClaims: Automotive MCU/CIS and several 8-inch power/analog products faced severe foundry-capacity shortages; auto IC qualification makes supply switching slow.
observedChanges: automotive semiconductor supply is structurally constrained

sourceItems.title: Purchasing Managers Index for May 2021
normalizedClaims: May manufacturing PMI 51.0 remained expansionary but new-orders growth slowed; supplier delivery time fell to 47.6, showing supply constraints.
observedChanges: manufacturing remains expanding but demand momentum slows

eventClusters.statement: Hog economics deteriorated from a high-price cycle into severe losses by late June, with the hog-to-grain ratio falling below 5:1 and triggering the highest official warning plus reserve-purchase intervention; spot hog prices had just begun a rebound from the June low.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: A reserve purchase can create a short rebound without restoring breeder profitability. Turning-point candidates need survival, cost and forward supply evidence.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is any listed breeder at a genuine earnings trough with survival and operating-leverage evidence, or is this too early to bottom-fish?

eventClusters.statement: Copper and other industrial commodities reached record highs amid tight supply and global recovery, but Chinese authorities then escalated anti-speculation measures and confirmed releases of copper/aluminum/zinc reserves, creating a classic high-profit-versus-policy/peak-duration conflict.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Spot profits may be spectacular while policy explicitly attempts to cap the price path. V1.2 must distinguish durable low-cost supply advantage from peak price extrapolation.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any A-share metals producer retain a superior normalized earnings path after policy intervention, or should peak profits be treated as already absorbed?

eventClusters.statement: China NEV sales/production continued growing at triple-digit rates through April-May, indicating a structural scale-up despite broader auto and component constraints.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Volume growth alone does not prove profit conversion and high-growth expectations may already be capitalized. Deep research must freeze the multi-year earnings path.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share NEV company converted structural volume growth into an incremental future earnings path rather than merely confirming already-premium expectations?

eventClusters.statement: Automotive semiconductor scarcity remained severe enough to force production curtailments, while long qualification cycles and full foundry utilization made the bottleneck difficult to resolve quickly.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Shortage hurts OEM volumes and may benefit qualified suppliers, but listed-company automotive revenue exposure must be directly auditable.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can any A-share chip supplier prove material auto-specific scarcity-to-profit conversion before cutoff?

eventClusters.statement: May manufacturing remained in expansion but new-order momentum slowed and supplier delivery times worsened, indicating strong activity with mounting input/supply constraints.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Useful as context across metals/auto/chips, not a direct stock thesis.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as cross-thesis input-cost and demand context.
